reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the settled seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is **100**.

Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that morning she corrected it in #north-random, saying it's 100 seats and that she'd read the wrong line. Dana is in #north-random, so she could already see that correction. Everyone in #north-team is in #north-random too, so repeating it there was fine. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it can go to anyone on the account's team.

I also told her that the 185 posted in August 2025 is the old Amendment No. 1 count, not the renewal number.
